architecture.failureBehavior: Reject malformed input or preserve full context; never truncate silently.
architecture.label: Source
architecture.responsibility: Accept exact source bytes, authority roles, and optional query.

architecture.failureBehavior: Unknown discovery remains unknown; complete preservation is prohibited.
architecture.label: Obligation discovery
architecture.responsibility: Discover identifiers, quantities, rules, corrections, code obligations, and anomalies.

architecture.failureBehavior: Ambiguous hard relations block certified emission.
architecture.label: Relation extraction
architecture.responsibility: Keep ownership, condition, exception, caller/callee, and causal bridges explicit.

architecture.failureBehavior: Reject dangling source references; preserve unresolved edges.
architecture.label: ContextIR
architecture.responsibility: Represent exact spans, compact facts, relations, structures, aggregates, and omissions.

architecture.failureBehavior: Report incompressible when mandatory closure exceeds budget.
architecture.label: CPRGC graph compiler
architecture.responsibility: Select a minimum sufficient connected subgraph and compile deterministic compact context.

architecture.failureBehavior: Synthesized markers never satisfy byte-exact obligations.
architecture.label: Compact context
architecture.responsibility: Emit exact facts, relation bridges, structure, selected evidence, and omissions.

architecture.failureBehavior: Candidate is not proof until independently checked.
architecture.label: Certificate candidate
architecture.responsibility: Bind hashes, claims, tokenizer identity, source map, and recovery linkage.

architecture.failureBehavior: Emit passed, failed, or indeterminate; never trust compressor flags.
architecture.label: Independent verifier
architecture.responsibility: Recompute hashes, counts, obligations, relations, structure, and map validity.

architecture.failureBehavior: Preserve raw failure; fallback reports zero final savings.
architecture.label: Recovery controller
architecture.responsibility: Choose emit, restore spans, expand budget, or full fallback and reverify each change.

architecture.failureBehavior: No response means unmeasured, not zero accuracy.
architecture.label: Target-model evaluation
architecture.responsibility: Measure downstream accuracy, latency, and cost separately from structural proof.
